## `[tiers]`

Per-tier wellhead settings. Tiers improve capacities, steam rate and drilling speed, never temperature.

### `[tiers.basic]`

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `energyCapacity` | `400000` | > 1 | Energy buffer (FE). |
| `maxEnergyInput` | `4000` | > 1 | Maximum energy accepted per tick (FE/t). |
| `drillEnergyPerBlock` | `4000` | > 0 | Energy consumed per drilled block (FE). |
| `drillTicksPerBlock` | `40` | 1 ~ 72000 | Ticks needed to drill one block. |
| `casingSlots` | `4` | 1 ~ 4 | Casing slots of the interface (64 casings each). |
| `debrisSlots` | `18` | 1 ~ 54 | Slots of the debris inventory. |
| `waterCapacity` | `32000` | > 1 | Water tank capacity (mB). |
| `steamCapacity` | `64000` | > 1 | Steam tank capacity (mB). Its fill ratio is the pressure. |
| `maxSteamRate` | `400` | 0 ~ 1000000 | Maximum steam output (mB/t) at temperature factor 1, without interference or exhaustion. |
| `controlEnergyPerTick` | `20` | > 0 | Energy consumed per tick by the control system once the column exists (FE/t). |

## `[drilling]`

Drilling

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `casingsPerBlock` | `1` | 1 ~ 64 | Steel well casings consumed per drilled block. |
| `autoStart` | `false` |  | Drilling starts by itself when the wellhead is placed and whenever the target is deeper, instead of waiting for the "Start drilling" button. Repairs of the column never wait for the button. |
| `targetChangeStopsDrilling` | `true` |  | Changing the target depth stops the drilling until the "Start drilling" button is pressed again. |
| `fakePlayerUsesOwnerProfile` | `true` |  | The drilling fake player uses the wellhead owner's profile, so claim mods apply the owner's permissions. |
| `columnCheckInterval` | `100` | 20 ~ 12000 | Ticks between two integrity checks of the casing column. |

## `[heat]`

Heat. Temperature depends on the absolute Y of the well bottom and on the dimension profile.

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boilingTemperature` | `100.0` | 0.0 ~ 10000.0 | Temperature (°C) under which no steam is produced. The temperature factor is 0 here. |
| `maxTemperature` | `250.0` | 1.0 ~ 10000.0 | Temperature (°C) at which the temperature factor reaches 1. |
| `maxTemperatureFactor` | `1.0` | 0.0 ~ 10.0 | Cap of the temperature factor. Above 1, lava around the bottom can push production past the tier max rate. |
| `dimensionProfiles` | `["minecraft:overworld=overworld", "minecraft:the_nether=nether", "minecraft:the_end=end"]` |  | Heat profile of each dimension, as "namespace:path=profile". Profiles: overworld, nether, end, other. Unlisted dimensions use the "other" profile. |

## `[production]`

Water to steam conversion

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `purgeEnabled` | `true` |  | Lose part of the water as blowdown. |
| `purgeRatio` | `0.05` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Fraction of the consumed water lost as blowdown: steam = water x (1 - purgeRatio). |
| `productionNeedsEnergy` | `false` |  | Stop producing steam when the wellhead has no energy. By default, boiling is passive and energy only powers the control system (automatic shutdown, low-water lock). |

## `[safety]`

Pressure is the fill ratio of the internal steam tank. The control system (automatic shutdown, low-water lock) runs on the wellhead energy (tier controlEnergyPerTick); without energy it cannot act. The emergency stop always works.

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `valveEnabled` | `true` |  | Enable the safety valve (needs air right above the wellhead). |
| `valveOpenThreshold` | `0.8` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Pressure at which the safety valve opens. |
| `valveVentRatio` | `0.5` | 0.0 ~ 10.0 | Steam the open valve can vent per tick, as a fraction of the max steam rate (upgrades included). It vents down to the opening threshold only. Under 1, the valve slows a pressure rise without stopping it, so the automatic shutdown stays reachable; at 1 or more, an unobstructed valve holds the pressure at its threshold. |
| `valveNeedsEnergy` | `false` |  | The valve needs energy to open. By default it is mechanical and only needs air above the wellhead. |
| `autoShutdownEnabled` | `true` |  | Enable the automatic shutdown on high pressure. |
| `autoShutdownThreshold` | `0.9` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Pressure at which production stops automatically. |
| `autoRestartThreshold` | `0.5` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Pressure under which production restarts after an automatic shutdown. |
| `lowWaterShutdownEnabled` | `true` |  | Once the water tank runs dry, keep production stopped until the water is back over the restart threshold. |
| `lowWaterRestartThreshold` | `0.1` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Water fill ratio over which production restarts after a low-water shutdown. |

## `[eruption]`

Eruption: the well is at full pressure, still heated and fed, and nothing relieves it (valve obstructed, disabled or unpowered, automatic shutdown disabled or unpowered). After the grace period, each second rolls the chance.

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"DISABLED"` | DISABLED, STEAM_JET, EXPLOSION | DISABLED, STEAM_JET (burn damage, no block damage) or EXPLOSION. |
| `gracePeriod` | `600` | 0 ~ 72000 | Ticks at full pressure before any eruption can happen. |
| `chancePerSecond` | `0.02` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Chance per second of an eruption once the grace period is over (0.02: about 50 s on average). |
| `steamJetRadius` | `5` | 1 ~ 32 | Radius (blocks) of the steam jet. |
| `steamJetDamage` | `8.0` | 0.0 ~ 1000.0 | Burn damage dealt by the steam jet. |
| `steamJetReleasedSteam` | `0.5` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Fraction of the steam tank released by a steam jet. |
| `explosionPower` | `4.0` | 0.0 ~ 20.0 | Explosion power (TNT = 4). |
| `explosionBreaksBlocks` | `true` |  | The explosion breaks blocks (through the standard explosion event, so claim mods can filter it). When false, it only hurts entities. |
| `explosionDropsWellhead` | `true` |  | The wellhead is blown off as an item that keeps its contents, like a dismantled wellhead. When false, it is destroyed with its contents (debris still drops). |

## `[exhaustion]`

Slow, reversible heat exhaustion, stored per column in the world data (it survives the wellhead). Per day, at a load L (steam made / tier max steam rate): exhaustion += gainPerDay x L - recoveryPerDay x max(0, 1 - L). A well without a loaded wellhead recovers at the idle rate. The defaults stay mild: at most 15 % of the rate, reached after about 15 days of continuous production (7.5 with 8 Speed upgrades), and a well under 83 % load never wears.

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` |  |  |
| `gainPerDay` | `0.01` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Exhaustion gained per Minecraft day (24000 ticks) at full load. |
| `recoveryPerDay` | `0.05` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Exhaustion recovered per Minecraft day while the well is idle. |
| `max` | `0.15` | 0.0 ~ 1.0 | Maximum exhaustion: the largest share of the steam rate it can take. |
| `countsUpgradedLoad` | `true` |  | Steam over the tier max steam rate (Speed upgrades) counts in the load: twice the steam, twice the wear. Off: the load is capped at 1. |

## `[upgrades]`

Mekanism Speed and Energy upgrades (Mekanism's upgrade tab, or sneak + right-click the wellhead with the upgrade). With n of the 8 upgrades, a multiplier M applies as M^(n/8), like Mekanism machines.

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` |  | Accept Mekanism Speed and Energy upgrades. |
| `speedMultiplier` | `10.0` | 1.0 ~ 1000.0 | Drilling speed factor with 8 Speed upgrades. Drilling energy per tick grows with its square, as in Mekanism. |
| `energyMultiplier` | `10.0` | 1.0 ~ 1000.0 | Energy use divisor with 8 Energy upgrades. |
| `energyRaisesCapacity` | `true` |  | Energy upgrades also multiply the energy buffer, as in Mekanism. |
| `speedAffectsSteam` | `true` |  | Speed upgrades also raise the max steam rate (off: they only speed up drilling). |
| `steamMultiplier` | `2.0` | 1.0 ~ 100.0 | Max steam rate factor with 8 Speed upgrades, when speedAffectsSteam is on. The water use follows. |
| `speedRaisesControlEnergy` | `true` |  | When Speed upgrades raise the steam rate, the control system energy grows with the square of that factor, as Mekanism machines (x4 with 8 Speed upgrades and the default steamMultiplier); Energy upgrades still divide it. |
